facts.fact: The Independent Electoral Commission says the definitive 2024-2025 voters' roll of 8,727,431 electors is a biometric file, whose biometrics stop remaining imperfections from affecting the integrity of the vote.
The Independent Electoral Commission says the definitive roll can be consulted from 4 June 2025 on its website and by SMS using the codes *919# or #919# on all mobile operators.

systems.platform: biometric file; website and SMS consultation (*919#)
